transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, my work physical is actually what got me here. The doctor there told me my weight is too low. Honestly, I don't really see it as a problem. I just feel lighter on my feet when I play basketball, and I don't feel as weighed down when I'm working at the garage.
Have you been actively trying to keep your weight down or lose weight?

Yeah, I suppose I do. Most days I just keep it to coffee in the morning. Then later on, maybe I'll have a small sandwich or just half of whatever is around. Between the shop running late and the house being so busy, I just feel better sticking to my own simple rules. It just works for me.
How do you feel about the possibility of gaining weight?

Honestly, I really don't like the idea. If I see the scale bump up even a pound, or... if my jeans feel tighter, I start thinking I'm getting soft. I just worry that I'll end up being slower moving around the cars at work, or up and down the court. So, yeah, I really want to avoid putting on any weight.
Have you noticed any decrease in your sexual interest or sex drive recently?
No, I can't say that I have. Uh, everything seems pretty normal in that department, honestly. I haven't noticed any drop in my drive or anything like that.
